# T-1: Resolve Git source target

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Define and implement deterministic target commit resolution for Git URL sources after fetch.

## Acceptance Criteria
- source.ref missing resolves to the remote default branch commit after fetch.
- source.ref branch, tag, and SHA-equivalent inputs resolve to stable commits after fetch.
- Resolved commit is used by install/materialize paths instead of stale cache HEAD.
- Resolved source root or materialized package tree files correspond to the resolved commit before metadata consumers inspect plugin.json.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on src/lib/plugin-registry.js around syncGitUrlSource(), resolveSource(), and installFromSource() callers. Keep sourceLocation() and maskPluginSource() behavior. Avoid project-specific fixed repository values.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests create throwaway Git repositories and assert R1/R2 behavior through public plugin registry or CLI paths.
